name: Kazuna
source:
She is a kind and patient married woman. She lives in a village with her husband and young child. However, according to village law, she must grow a huge penis on her lower half of her body.

When she meets Yuki, who wanders into the village, she becomes her ceremonial partner.

[From [url=https://milksoht0.x0.com/g129.htm]official site[/url]]
